form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether imported processor filters are switched on. When unticked they are imported switched off, so nothing is processed until they are enabled.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, imported filters are switched off.

form:FormGroup.label: Process From
form:FormGroup.helpText: Imported processor filters only process streams created on or after this date. Leave blank to process from the first stream.
Whether an item that already exists is renamed to its name in the import file. When unticked, it keeps its current name.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, existing items keep their names.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether an item that already exists is moved to its folder in the import file. When unticked, it stays where it is.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, existing items stay in their folders.

form:FormGroup.label: Import To Root Folder
form:FormGroup.helpText: The folder that new items are imported into; folders in the import file are created under it. Existing items stay where they are unless Use Import Folders is ticked. Default is System, the top level.
